أخرنمس (form IIIq)
# أَخْرَنْمِسُ (ʔaḵranmisu) /ʔax.ran.mi.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْرَنْمَسَ (iḵranmasa)
# أَخْرَنْمِسَ (ʔaḵranmisa) /ʔax.ran.mi.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْرَنْمَسَ (iḵranmasa)
# أَخْرَنْمِسْ (ʔaḵranmis) /ʔax.ran.mis/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِخْرَنْمَسَ (iḵranmasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
